title: North Yorkshire Council: Using AI to reimagine Children’s Social Care
summary: North Yorkshire reports 90% less time and cost for some data-retrieval tasks in its Azure AI proof of concept, plus relationship-mapping tools.
account: North Yorkshire developed an Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and relationship maps in children's social-care records. Some data retrieval tasks reportedly required 90% less time and cost in the proof of concept. No completed safeguarding intervention or real-world service outcome is specified. The benefit is demonstrated task efficiency in a proof of concept. Operational adoption and improved safeguarding outcomes remain unestablished.
purpose: Improve retrieval and interpretation of children’s social-care records, including relationships among people and cases.
system: Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and automatically generated eco-maps in Liquidlogic LCS records
developer: North Yorkshire Council using Microsoft Azure AI

ratings.reason: Selected retrieval tasks reportedly cost less and take less time in testing. Depth 1 describes that task-level gain, without implying production-wide savings.
Faster retrieval and automatic relationship maps reduce effort on the tested tasks. Improved child safety is not established.

ai_role.statement: The proof of concept uses AI to search structured and unstructured case information and generate relationship maps. The reported 90% reduction concerns selected test tasks, not established production-wide savings or improved safeguarding outcomes.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: North Yorkshire Council: Using AI to reimagine Children’s Social Care

produced_by: The project uses existing Liquidlogic case-management material, including notes, forms, and images.
It was supported by the Department for Education’s Data and Digital Solutions Fund and evaluated as a proof of concept.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: North Yorkshire reports faster social-care data retrieval

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
